system.description:
Level 1. Once per Player Phase.

Select a target; they roll Magykal Resistance. On failure they suffer the chosen Hex's effect until the start of the next Player Phase.

Starting Hexes (Level 1): Sicken, Bind, Deny

Level 4 Hexes: Mutilate, Enrage, Panic

Level 8 Hexes: Surge, Rise, Give

Level 12 Hexes: Addle, Suffer, Delude

See Wytch Hexes compendium folder for individual Hex entries.
